title: feat(pm/fleet-write): the relay token carries workflows write on every stroke, spent by automerge_enable on a pull that changes a workflow file
body:
Fixes #22708
Clause-②: no

**Ruling A** on the card (comment 6104822731; maintainer 「22708 A」): the fleet relay's App token carries `workflows: write` on every stroke, so a seat may enqueue a pull that changes `.github/workflows/**`. This PR is that change, and it is itself the last workflow-file pull a human enqueues: it changes `fleet-write.yml`, so the token it widens cannot land it.

**Who wrote it, and under which rule.** The PM seat itself (skills seat 2, `session_011u73oxZ5X95qrARPTeoU6v`), not an os-dev, under the PM red line's one exception: a maintainer's explicit per-PR authorization of an internal-tooling PR. The authorization, verbatim, from the maintainer in this seat's session chat at 2026-10-11T10:52Z: 「22708 你可以处理:执行 objectstack-ai/objectstack#22708 裁决 A:按该卡开发报告(评论 6106463015)里 deviations D1、D2 的说明,修改 scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs、.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml、scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs。跑 validate.mjs、execute.mjs、dispatch.mjs 的 --self-test 和相关 gates,然后开 draft PR。」 The first dev's attempt (report 6106463015) was stopped by the session's permission classifier at the `validate.mjs` pins; its measured premises and its prepared `ops.mjs` + `fleet-write.yml` patch are used here unchanged.

## What changed

- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`: `PERMISSIONS` gains `workflows: 'write'` between `contents` and `metadata` (the order the mint's literal list and the pins compare); the `automerge_enable` row gains `alsoSpends: Object.freeze(['workflows'])`; the header's permission paragraph, the `PERMISSIONS` JSDoc, the `alsoSpends` field doc and the transfer section's "one widening" sentence are updated, and the lowered human floor is recorded beside the grant with the ruling's comment id. `STROKE_SCOPED_PERMISSIONS` is unchanged: the grant is literal, not per stroke.
- `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml`: the mint step declares the literal `permission-workflows: write` after `permission-contents`, with a ONE-consumer comment; the header's grant list and the two "four grants" sentences read five.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`: the alsoSpends pin expects `[['pr_create', ['issues']], ['automerge_enable', ['workflows']]]`; the map pin and the token-grants pin carry the fifth grant; two new cases in the refused-by-construction battery (floor 20 to 22): `workflows` is spent by `automerge_enable` alone as `alsoSpends` and is no row's `permission`; `PERMISSIONS` minus `metadata` equals the union of every row's `permission` and `alsoSpends`, both exactly `actions / contents / issues / pull-requests / workflows`. The `tokenPermissionsOf` doc comment says five.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md:67` (Tier S; one line for one line, 117 bytes; the file stays 101/101): diagnostic step ③ now reads the token as carrying `workflows: write` by the ruling, so a refusal there is a grant drift (the App's accepted permissions), not a missing grant.
- ⛔ No new gate. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:263` (the human-floor sentence) is untouched.

## Verification (head `db16cfc7d`; base `b7cd1af9d`, `origin/main` when the worktree was cut)

- Red-before control: with only `PERMISSIONS` widened and the pins at base, `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` exits 1, "3 of 128 case(s) failed" (the alsoSpends pin, the map pin, the token-grants pin). After the pins: 130 cases pass across 10 batteries. `execute.mjs --self-test` 111 cases and `dispatch.mjs --self-test` 216 cases, exit 0; `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-validate`, `-execute`, `-dispatch` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` from the worktree with no paths derived 61 commands at `b7cd1af9d`; every one ran alone with its exit captured before any pipe (the tool's documented idiom); the reconciliation line: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 61 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt); the `@objectstack/lint...` closure was built under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0, 141 s) and the rerun exits 0. `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (the long battery) exit 0.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet`: `landing-operations.md is 101 lines (ceiling 101; headroom 0)`. `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:required-contexts`, `check-self-test-wired`, `check-self-test-workflow-commands`, `check-whole-set-label-write`, `check-scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check-ci-filter-parity` exit 0 (all in the 61).
- No package source changes, so no package build or test is owed beyond the gates. Changeset: none; `scripts/pm/**`, `.github/**` and `.claude/**` ship in no package's `files[]`, so the PR takes `skip-changeset`.

## Premises (report 6106463015, re-read on this base)

- A1: `actions/create-github-app-token@v3` declares the `permission-workflows` input (`action.yml:143`, read at the tag ref; the sha read was refused by the proxy).
- A3: `execute.mjs` has no token-grant surface (`PERMISSIONS` imported at `:164`, used nowhere), so the pin lives in `validate.mjs`.
- `REFUSED_PATH_FAMILIES` carries `/\/git\//` and `/\/contents\//`, so the wider token reaches no file write through any row; the refused-by-construction battery pins that over every path every op can spell.

## Risk the maintainer checks before this merges (NOT MEASURED from the seat)

The mint step requests `permission-workflows: write` on EVERY relay stroke. If the objectstack-fleet App's registration, or the organization installation's accepted permissions, lacks **Workflows: Read and write**, `actions/create-github-app-token` fails on every stroke: every relay write stops, not only this class of pull. `/app/**` is unreachable from seat egress, so this cannot be read here. Check: the App's Repository permissions show Workflows = Read and write, and the installation on `objectstack-ai` has accepted that change. The first relay stroke after the merge is the measurement; if the mint fails, revert this PR.

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED, owed on #22708 after the merge: the first pull the widened token enqueues.
- `pr_update_branch` on a pull whose base brought workflow-file changes may also need `workflows` (the platform's merge commit changes workflow files on the head); the literal grant covers it either way, so no `alsoSpends` beyond the ruling's row.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs:164` imports `PERMISSIONS` and never uses it (a dead import; noted, not filed).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:车队中继(fleet-write)铸出的 App 令牌在每一笔写上常驻 `workflows: write`;`automerge_enable` 行登记它花费这项授权(改 `.github/workflows/**` 的 PR 入队需要);validate 自测钉死:授权集与 workflow 字面输入一致、`workflows` 只由该行花费、授权集不比各行所花更宽。另把 `landing-operations.md` 里「token 缺 workflows 权限」那条诊断改成「令牌常驻该权限,仍拒即授权漂移」。不加门禁。

**为什么改**:你裁了 A(「22708 A」):以后改 CI 工作流文件的 PR 由席位中继入队,不再每张等人点一下。本 PR 自己也改了工作流文件,所以它是最后一张需要人点入队的。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:最大风险在 App 侧:铸币会在每一笔申请 `permission-workflows: write`;若 App 注册或组织安装没接受 Workflows 读写权限,每一笔中继写都在铸币处失败,整个中继停摆,不只这一类 PR。席位测不了这项(到不了 `/app/**`)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。代价:令牌权限面永久多一项(可改写工作流文件的能力),安全/权限边界的人工地板为这一项降低,出处已写在代码旁。

**席位意见**:(席位在评论里定稿)

**你要做的**:两步。① 先确认 objectstack-fleet App 的 Repository permissions 里 Workflows 为 Read and write,且组织安装已接受;② 然后点一次 ready + auto-merge(或入队)。合并后第一笔中继写就是实测,失败即 revert。
